# Variable `FONT_EXTRA_RDEPENDS`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

When inheriting the fontcache class, this variable specifies the runtime dependencies for font packages. By default, the FONT_EXTRA_RDEPENDS is set to “fontconfig-utils”.

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-FONT_EXTRA_RDEPENDS)
